title: Sell the Benefit, Not the Feature: The iPod Lesson
description:
Sell the benefit, not the feature: people buy what your product does for them, not what it has.
Follow MarketOpsTips for a quick marketing tip every morning.

#marketing #copywriting #shorts

beats.say: Nobody wants a drill. They want the hole in the wall.
That's the difference between a feature and a benefit.
A feature is what your product has. A benefit is what your customer gets.
In 2001, the iPod was sold with one simple line.
1,000 songs in your pocket. You could picture it right away.
So rewrite the first line of your ad. Say the result, not the parts.
What does your customer really get?
